title: Leonida Platinum - GTA VI Trophy Guide
sourcesNote: Every guide below is original text written for this app. Unlock facts are cross-checked against at least two community trophy references per trophy (PowerPyx, PSNProfiles, PlayStationTrophies.org, GTA Forums and the GTA Wiki).

roadmap.title: Prologue & Leonida Shores
roadmap.detail: Clear the opening chapters and grab the early missables: the Ocean Beach cocktail, showroom smash and bowling alley visit before their venues close.

roadmap.title: Vice City & Beach Money
roadmap.detail: Push into Vice City. Sweep early exploration (The Goodtime State) and the one-off venue trophies in this window.

roadmap.title: Backwoods & First Strands
roadmap.detail: Start stranger strands, vehicle discovery and the WAiNK sweep. All Chapter 3-4 missables are still open.

roadmap.title: Downtown & High Rollers
roadmap.detail: Activities, races, drone races, shooting range golds and the VCIA departure missable live in this stretch.

roadmap.title: Heist Arc Begins
roadmap.detail: Heists, partner wanted-level and shop-spree missables plus collectible sets. Keep pre-choice saves handy.

roadmap.title: The Score
roadmap.detail: Every character strand must finish before the point of no return; also the Rhino missable and the vault heists.

roadmap.title: Heat Wave
roadmap.detail: Statewide cleanup: gang operations, laundering $250,000 and property buying while the manhunt missions push the story forward.

roadmap.title: Endgame & Platinum Cleanup
roadmap.detail: Play the final choices from saved games, reach 100% completion, then sweep anything left for the platinum.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment your last open trophy unlocks, so the only real planning is protecting the missables while the story is still running. Keep pre-choice saves and finish venue-based one-offs early. Sources: PowerPyx platinum roadmap; PSNProfiles trophy overview.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Complete the Gone Fishing mission. It is unmissable story content: follow the boating prompts and hold the fish-fight minigame steady to the end. Sources: PowerPyx mission walkthrough; PSNProfiles guide thread.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. No side content is required - play the story linearly and the trophy unlocks with the chapter's ending cutscene. Sources: PowerPyx walkthrough; PSNProfiles chapter list.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2. Money missions here can be replayed later for cash, so just push the story. Sources: PowerPyx walkthrough; PSNProfiles guide.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. A Vice City focused chapter; keep an eye on the partner missables flagged separately in this guide. Sources: PowerPyx walkthrough; PlayStationTrophies.org forum notes.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4. Choice-heavy missions appear here; choices do not affect trophy progress, but keep a manual save before each. Sources: PowerPyx walkthrough; GTA Wiki chapter summary.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission. Finish all open strands first if you want a clean credits run, then watch the ending roll. Sources: PowerPyx ending guide; PSNProfiles completion thread.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the Breakfast Run mission. A straightforward drive-and-deliver; unmissable story content. Sources: PowerPyx walkthrough; PSNProfiles guide.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist. Bring a heavy vest, use cover inside the vault and exfiltrate with the crew vehicle for a clean run. Sources: PowerPyx heist walkthrough; GTA Forums heist tips.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete Child's Play. Mostly narrative - keep pace with the objective marker and it unlocks itself. Sources: PowerPyx walkthrough; PSNProfiles guide.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete Headliners. The stage-set finale plays out linearly; no special preparation needed. Sources: PowerPyx walkthrough; PlayStationTrophies.org notes.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete VCIA Takedown. Chase the runway targets; a fast car from the impound makes the airport leg trivial. Sources: PowerPyx walkthrough; GTA Forums chase tips.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete Operation Savage Glory. A large assault mission - stock up on ammo beforehand and use explosive pickups liberally. Sources: PowerPyx walkthrough; PSNProfiles guide.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Attain 100% in-game completion per the pause-menu checklist: story, strangers, activities, collectible sets and exploration objectives. Sources: PowerPyx 100% checklist; PSNProfiles completion guide.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Perform 250 stunts across Leonida. The swamp boardwalk and airport loops are efficient stunt farms; chain jumps, drifts and near-misses. Sources: PowerPyx stunt guide; GTA Forums stunt locations.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each activity type once - fishing, races, arcade, meditation, hunting and whatever else the pause menu lists. One attempt of each is enough. Sources: PowerPyx activities list; PSNProfiles guide.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn gold in every Shooting Range challenge. Gold wants 80%+ accuracy and fast target transitions, so practice each weapon class. Sources: PowerPyx range guide; PSNProfiles tips thread.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every location. Learn the shortcut gates; a respawn costs more time than a clean line. Sources: PowerPyx race guide; GTA Forums drone race tips.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Lower-difficulty street races count; restart a lost race immediately to save time. Sources: PowerPyx race guide; PSNProfiles guide.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in the fishing challenge. Use the lure he suggests, hook early and reel with smooth strokes to out-pace his catch. Sources: PowerPyx fishing guide; PSNProfiles forum tips.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game once. Insert coins at any arcade venue and reach the simple score threshold. Sources: PowerPyx arcade list; PSNProfiles guide.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete Andy's final mission strand. His strand expires at a story checkpoint, so finish it before pushing the last chapters. Sources: PowerPyx strangers guide; PSNProfiles strand notes.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete Kenton's final mission strand - before the point-of-no-return save, like the other strands. Sources: PowerPyx strangers guide; PlayStationTrophies.org notes.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete Billy's final mission strand. Vehicle-heavy; bring an armored car for the last leg. Sources: PowerPyx strangers guide; GTA Forums strand tips.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. There are more than 8 in the state, so pick the nearest ones to your story route. Sources: PowerPyx strangers map; PSNProfiles guide.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete Randy's final mission strand. The surveillance leg is easiest with the scoped rifle. Sources: PowerPyx strangers guide; PSNProfiles strand notes.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete Tyrone's final mission strand. A music-venue finale with a getaway drive - keep the car intact for the clean exit. Sources: PowerPyx strangers guide; GTA Forums tips.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida. They persist after the story, so sweep them in free roam. Sources: PowerPyx locations map; PSNProfiles collectible guide.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal for Bret. Dawn spawns are best and each target wants the rifle listed in its tracking notes. Sources: PowerPyx hunting guide; PSNProfiles notes.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. The beach and downtown sets are the quickest sweep; cards persist after the story. Sources: PowerPyx card locations; PSNProfiles collectible guide.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Landmarks, buildings and points of interest all register; do one district per session. Sources: PowerPyx WAiNK guide; GTA Forums location list.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges from the challenge board. Most complete naturally during free roam cleanup. Sources: PowerPyx challenge list; PSNProfiles guide.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level together with your partner and escape clean. The window closes once your partner leaves the roster, so do it mid-story. Sources: PowerPyx wanted-level tips; PSNProfiles forum thread.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Plan three adjacent stores and swap vehicles between stops. Missable after the partner leaves. Sources: PowerPyx robbery guide; PSNProfiles tips.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 distinct vehicles by driving them. Rotate through parking lots, dealerships and traffic; each new model registers once. Sources: PowerPyx vehicle list; PSNProfiles guide.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in one Combat Focus activation. Group targets in a dense mission and land headshots under Focus. Sources: PowerPyx combat guide; GTA Forums tips.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA by driving straight through the airport gates. The layout changes late in the story, so do it early. Sources: PowerPyx location guide; PSNProfiles forum thread.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Operate a Rhino tank in free roam. It is only available during the base raid window that closes after a certain chapter - do not skip it. Sources: PowerPyx vehicle guide; GTA Forums military-base tips.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store undetected. Enter in the quiet window, subdue the guard instantly and finish before the timer. Missable if the window passes. Sources: PowerPyx stealth guide; PSNProfiles thread.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each one. Vault heists unlock progressively; always exit via the marked route. Sources: PowerPyx heist guide; PSNProfiles guide.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Stop a transport on the interstate, crack the rear doors and lose the heat fast. Sources: PowerPyx money guide; GTA Forums spawn tips.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida - every district, waterway and landmark flagged on the map, tracked as fog-of-war in the pause menu. Sources: PowerPyx map checklist; PSNProfiles guide.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang. Operations cycle on the map; hit one per gang before the roster rotates. Sources: PowerPyx operations list; PSNProfiles guide.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach at the beachfront bar's rooftop. The venue only opens in the early-game window - miss it and the trophy is gone. Sources: PowerPyx location guide; PSNProfiles forum notes.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash out of a vehicle showroom by driving a car through the downtown showroom's glass front. The showroom's story role ends later, closing the window. Sources: PowerPyx stunt guide; GTA Forums tips.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through a full roll at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley, which only operates during its chapter window. Sources: PowerPyx activities guide; PSNProfiles notes.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Make the partnership choice with mass appeal. Save manually before the decision scene so you can replay it for the other ending later. Sources: PowerPyx endings guide; PSNProfiles choice thread.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Act on the better-or-worse choice in a late-story scene. Keep a pre-choice save. Sources: PowerPyx endings guide; PlayStationTrophies.org notes.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Get a second chance on the bad-luck event. Its retry window closes after the next mission, so take the chance immediately. Sources: PowerPyx walkthrough; PSNProfiles forum thread.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: See the truth event through to its reveal in the late-story missions around it. Skippable if you rush - do not. Sources: PowerPyx endings guide; GTA Forums discussion.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by: hurl a bowling ball from a moving vehicle through the alley's open doors. Sources: PowerPyx stunt guide; GTA Forums tips thread.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills. Deposit the marked cash in chunks at any contact drop; the counter is cumulative. Sources: PowerPyx money guide; PSNProfiles guide.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shop types. Clothing, guns, cars and snacks all count, cumulatively. Sources: PowerPyx shops list; PSNProfiles guide.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties from the realtor. Buy them as income allows; the last purchase pops the trophy. Sources: PowerPyx properties list; PSNProfiles guide.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Summon the app and register any 10 vehicles you drive; the counter tracks them. Sources: PowerPyx app guide; GTA Forums tips.
